propositions: Project overlay entries keyed by built-in overlay id cannot currently contribute `trigger_tokens` or extend committed `applies_to` globs, limiting the parent epic's two-tier trigger design.

A new helper `project_trigger_extensions(repo_root)` must read project overlay raw entries directly and return per-built-in-id dictionaries of `trigger_tokens` and `applies_to` lists for union with committed values.
Both `glob_triggered_overlays` and `content_triggered_overlays` must union project-supplied trigger tokens and globs with committed ones, with `repo_root` threaded from `overlay_union` call site.

Project `trigger_tokens` matching case-sensitively against added/removed diff lines (excluding file headers) and project `applies_to` globs unioning with committed globs must preserve ADR 0074 semantics for empty gates and escalation-only behavior.
With no project overlay present, both trigger functions must produce byte-identical results to current behavior, validated by unmodified pre-existing tests and explicit no-overlay unit cases.
